cluster_version.description: df -h on each PE (fan-out to all SVMs via svmips) and on each PC (run directly).

cassandra_node_consistency.description: Runs nodetool ring to verify Cassandra consistency

curator_full_scan.description: Last successful Curator scans of each PE, parsed by collectors/scripts/curator_full_scan.py. curator_cli is cluster-wide, so the loop stops at the first CVM reachable over SSH (exit 255 means SSH failed). The CZMON_* lines record the curator_cli exit code and the cluster VIP.
command: /usr/local/nutanix/bin/curator_cli get_last_successful_scans 2>&1 | grep -v -E ^[IWEF][0-9]{8}; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo CZMON_EXIT_CODE=$rc; echo CZMON_$(zeus_config_printer 2>/dev/null | grep ^cluster_external_ip); [ $rc -ne 255 ] && break
